name: list_runs
description: This agent's own history, newest first, in three kinds of item. A RUN is one of its runs with what it did: its intent, when it started, how many changes it applied, held, had refused or saw reverted, the rows it wrote and the resources it wrote to. A REVERT is a revert the person signed for this agent: its scope, how many rows it restored and skipped, and its intent. LOOSE_READS is the reads this agent made outside any run in one UTC hour: how many, and which resources; run_history with from and to lists them. Use it to find the run the person means ("what you did yesterday on leads") before run_history, preview_revert and request_revert, and to answer "what happened" without missing a revert or a read made outside a run. Without startTime or endTime you get the newest items; you do not have to ask the person for a period. startTime and endTime filter on each item's time: a run's start, a revert's signature, the start of the hour. Only this agent's records are listed. Cursor-paginated.

startTime.description: Only items at or after this time (RFC 3339): a run's start, a revert's signature, the start of a LOOSE_READS hour.

endTime.description: Only items before this time (RFC 3339), by the same time. Must be after startTime when both are given.

sort.description: id or -id. Default -id (newest first). Items are ordered by their time, then kind, then id.

lastChangeAt.description: When the run's latest change record (read or write) was made. Absent for a run with none.

applied.description: Writes applied (status APPLIED, op INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE).

held.description: Writes still waiting for the person's approval (APPROVAL_PENDING).

reverted.description: Writes reverted in full (REVERTED). A partly reverted write counts as applied; run_history shows its revertedBy.

reads.description: Reads recorded in the run (op READ).

rowsWritten.description: Rows written by the applied and reverted writes, cascaded rows included.

resources.description: Resources the run wrote to, in the store's form (schema.table in Postgres) (CONTRACT.md, Stores, What every store writes), at most 10, in name order.

resourcesTruncated.description: True when the run wrote to more than 10 resources; run_history has them all.

scopeId.description: The change, run or task the revert covered.

signedAt.description: When the person signed the revert. The item's place in the list.

skipped.description: Rows skipped because they changed since.

from.description: Start of the UTC hour, inclusive.

reads.description: Reads recorded in the hour outside any run (op READ, status APPLIED).

resources.description: Resources the reads named, in the store's form, at most 10, in name order.

resourcesTruncated.description: True when the reads named more than 10 resources.
